evidence.excerpt: Someone who joined a Medicare Advantage plan when they first became eligible at 65 has a trial right: if they leave that plan within the first 12 months, they can buy a Medigap policy with guaranteed issue, meaning the insurer cannot refuse them or charge more because of their health.
